title: Treasure gates dribbling
summary: Every player dribbles through as many gates as they can in 30 seconds.

steps.instruction: Set 8 gates, two cones each, spread across the area.
Each player has a ball. On the whistle, dribble through any gate. Count your gates.
Repeat three rounds. Players try to beat their own score.

progressions.change: A new gate only counts if it is a different one from the last.

safetyNotes: Keep the area clear of loose balls.
